relevance_note:
Case series of two Danon disease patients with a LAMP2 variant and two relatives: "two Danon disease patients (a 22-year-old man and his
48-year-old mother), who had a LAMP2 c.864G>A p. Val288Val mutation".
method_note: Hand-read; a short Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON and checked every span verbatim. Scope: Cases 1 and 2 carry the LAMP2 variant; Case 3 (maternal aunt, tested negative) and Case 4 (father, untested, described with CMR findings) are relatives described in relation to Case 1 and get rows but no variant rows. Case 1 inheritance recorded as inherited maternal because his mother (Case 2) carries 'the same LAMP2 gene mutation'. Case 1 age at onset left 'not reported': the AV block at 12 was asymptomatic and found at a medical check. Temporal changes in Case 1 (no obvious LGE at 12 then marked LGE at 19; normal LVEF at 19 then reduced at 22; NYHA I without obvious HF symptoms at 22 then HF episode at 23) are recorded in severity_or_detail, not as excluded rows. Statements about 'They both' (Cases 3 and 4) are recorded with evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'. 'no evident symptoms of psychological or musculoskeletal disorders' (Case 1) was taken to exclude the checklist items proximal muscle weakness and mood or anxiety disorder only; cognitive and ADHD items left not reported. Case 3: normal LVEF alone does not exclude the composite 'dilated or hypokinetic left ventricle' item (dilation not addressed), so left not reported; heart failure excluded from 'no previous history of cardiac disease'. Normal blood pressure and whole-exam statements ('no remarkable findings of physical examination', 'Her CMR showed normal findings') were not converted to specific features beyond what they name. Contradictions: Case 4 native T1 (1163 ms) and ECV fraction (21.6%) are called low in the text, timeline and Discussion but normal in the Figure 2 legend; both rows are emitted for each and no checklist item depends on them. Case 3 is '47-year-old' in the text but the timeline gives '46 years' for her CMR. Case 2 ECV fraction 32.4% is called normal although the stated reference range for Case 1 is 28 ± 3%; recorded as the paper states. The variant was described as 'previously reported' (ref 6) but the paper does not say these patients were previously reported, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null. No variant class or pathogenicity is stated.
